text:
maria: heads-up: apollo customer LoRA (apollo-lora-v2) failing some quick-eval numeric formatting when run with int4. Seen comma drop in invoice outputs. @chris @devon
chris: can you paste the eval id + a minimal failing example?
maria: eval id apollo-58. command: ```./rundev eval --pack apollo-quick-58 --model base-13b --adapter apollo-lora-v2 --quant int4 --batch 32``` failing snippet: ```Expected: "Invoice total: $1,234.56"  Got: "Invoice total: $1234.56"```
devon: does base-13b+int4 without the adapter reproduce?
maria: no. base-13b int4 alone shows comma fine. adapter on fp16 also fine. so adapter+int4 interaction.
akshat: any vocab/tokens added by the LoRA? token remap could collapse comma + digit into single token.
maria: customer pipeline injects <AMT> but adapter metadata says no_vocab_changes. adapter is just weight deltas.
jess: i'll run a tokenizer diff on the minimal prompt. quick test: ```python -c "from transformers import AutoTokenizer; t=AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('base-13b'); print(t.encode('1,234'), t.encode('1234'))"```
eval-bot: quick-eval apollo-58 complete: pass 66/100, fail 34. top fail class: numeric formatting (17 cases). report: https://ci.internal/reports/apollo-58/fails.csv
chris: i'll repro locally with kv-cache padding + different chunk sizes. maria, paste the minimal prompt you used.
maria: Prompt: "You are an invoice parser. Extract the invoice total." Input: "Total due: $1,234.56"
devon: looking at quant recipe: we use grouped int4 (per-channel) with symmetric scales. LoRA deltas can drive small shifts in embedding->ffn that round differently.
akshat: quick experiment idea: run inference with adapter weights cast/kept in int8 while base stays int4, or just fallback adapter path to int8. if that fixes it we can add an inference policy.
maria: running int8 fallback now on the same pack, will report.
jess: i'll add 25 synthetic amount cases (commas, dots, spaces, locales) to apollo-quick tests. opening PR to infra/tests after verifying.
devon: i'll take weight-diff investigation (embedding & first FF). will post weight delta heatmap + top-k token overlaps in ~2h.
chris: plan: 1) repro 2) try int8 adapter fallback 3) inspect LoRA weight deltas + tokenizer alignments 4) add targeted unit test to quick-eval and block rollout until fixed. assigning devon for weight diffs, maria for testcases.
maria: if int8 fixes, we add temp policy: prefer int8 when adapter metadata indicates no_vocab_changes? or better: detect numeric-format-sensitive evals and prefer int8 there.
akshat: good point. also check if LoRA touches layernorm scaling — small LN shifts can alter rounding.
jess: PR: infra/tests#789 adding synthetic amounts + link to failing examples.
eval-bot: rerun apollo-58 using adapter-int8-fallback: pass 90/100, fail 10. numeric formatting failures down to 2. (link: https://ci.internal/reports/apollo-58/int8-fallback/)
maria: int8 fallback mostly mitigates. Nate/eng-infra might want a perf cost note.
chris: cost tradeoff ok short term. long term we should identify root cause and patch LoRA merging or quant binder.
devon: posted heatmap: weight deltas concentrated on embedding rows for "," and digits. looks like adapter shifts comma embedding magnitude. investigating token alignment.
akshat: if adapter shifts embeddings for punctuation, quantization scale boundaries could move comma into neighbor token representation. solution paths: clamp LoRA deltas on embedding layer, or special-case punctuation tokens during quantization.
maria: opening a request with cust success to pause rollout until we have either unit test + policy. tagging @chris for release hold.
chris: ack. thanks all :thumbsup:
